Inactive0 initializes frame with tailnonce=sequence+1; active2 validates same nonce/cleanup, 0<fence_nonce<=sequence. recover_semantics: Requireguard0/no activeframe; guard1 around genuine System transfer1lamport controller->marker; increment only local probe_recovery_counter; restore0. guardbit0=>8104,barrier=>8105. No H Recover/native fee withdrawal.
redeem_semantics: Requireprior0/2; setprior|1, native System transfer1lamport controller->marker, restoreprior; no actual HTFP redemption/payout modeled.
settlement_semantics: Requireactiveguard2 and matching actual final proof tail. Open only phase0 and sequence>0, temp derives [m4b-proof-wsol,M,(volume.sequence-1)u64LE] under proof_program; native setup exactly SETTLEMENT.md using own reserve/settle/temp and arbitrary compatible storage_payer. Freeze temp sequence in phase1 record. Close only phase1/same payer,temp,record,frame; setguard3 around CPIs; derive O from actual native lamport+token deltas, close/refundD/restoreP, phase2/guard2. No sequence/credit change. No second opening in phase2 before final. Active Final requires0<fence_nonce<=sequence, rejects phase1, permits recordphase0/2, clears frame and completed record with no CPI. Idleguard0 Final requires inactive zero frame, recordphase0 with zero fields afterbinding, nonce=sequence+1 (nooverflow); succeeds without write/event. These checks are additional helper lifecycle constraints; future H Process settles internally and needs no record account.
